# Deveron Gastro Pub

> Restaurant and gastro pub in Mali Lošinj, Croatia (island of Lošinj), near the harbour. Fresh fish and seafood, homemade pasta and ravioli, risottos, meat dishes, pizza, breakfast, desserts, cocktails, gin & tonic, beer and Croatian wines. Rated 12.5/20 by Gault&Millau Croatia.

- Address: Ulica Vladimira Gortana 32, 51550 Mali Lošinj, Croatia
- Phone: +385 51 231 234
- Open every day 08:00–24:00, kitchen 08:00–22:00, closed on 25 December
- Reservations: https://deveron-gastro-pub-1683645478.resos.com/booking
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/deveronpub/
- Prices in euros

## Menu

- [Full menu with prices and allergens (HR/EN)](https://deveronpub.com/jelovnik.html): the current menu. Use only dishes listed there.
- [Interactive menu in 16 languages](https://deveronpub.com/#menu)

## Notes

- Signature dishes: ravioli with scallops and prawns in crab and caviar sauce, ravioli with truffle, Lošinj cuttlefish risotto, Dalmatian pašticada with gnocchi, fish platter for two, buzara, ražnjić Deveron.
- Club sandwich is served at breakfast only.
- Guests at a table can order from their phone by scanning the QR code on the table.
